name: Abecarnil
summary: Abecarnil (developmental code name ZK-112,119) is an anxiolytic drug from the β-carboline family. It is one of a relatively recently developed class of medicines known as the nonbenzodiazepines, which have similar effects to the older benzodiazepine group, but with quite different chemical structures. It is a partial agonist acting selectively at the benzodiazepine site of the GABAA receptor.

pharmacology.text: It is a partial agonist acting selectively at the benzodiazepine site of the GABAA receptor.
pharmacology.kind: GABAA receptor positive allosteric modulator; Anxiolytic

uses.text: It is one of a relatively recently developed class of medicines known as the nonbenzodiazepines, which have similar effects to the older benzodiazepine group, but with quite different chemical structures.

summaryZh: 阿貝卡爾（英語：Abecarnil，代號：ZK-112,119）是一種來自β-咔啉家族的抗焦慮藥。它是相對較新開發的一類藥物之一，稱為非苯二氮平類藥物，與較早的苯二氮平類藥物具有相似的作用，但化學結構截然不同。它是一種部分激動劑，選擇性地作用於GABAA受體的苯二氮平位點。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs acting at this site, such as the benzodiazepines, cause drowsiness, poor coordination, dizziness and slowed reactions, and regular use can lead to dependence and dangerous withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。作用於這個結合位的藥物（例如苯二氮平類）會引起嗜睡、協調變差、頭暈與反應變慢，長期使用可能導致依賴與危險的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。作用于这个结合位的药物（例如苯二氮平类）会引起嗜睡、协调制差、头晕与反应变慢，长期使用可能导致依赖与危险的戒断反应。

fact.en: It is a β-carboline, the same chemical family as harmine from Syrian rue, yet it acts at the benzodiazepine site of the GABA-A receptor rather than on serotonin.
fact.zh: 它是一種β-咔啉，與敘利亞芸香中的駱駝蓬鹼（harmine）屬於同一化學家族，但它作用於GABA-A受體上的苯二氮平結合位，而不是血清素系統。
fact.zhHans: 它是一种β-咔啉，与叙利亚芸香中的骆驼蓬碱（harmine）属于同一化学家族，但它作用于GABA-A受体上的苯二氮平结合位，而不是血清素系统。
